The '''''Drammel''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The ''Drammel'' was a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="Stats" /> [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].<ref name="Showdown" /> 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ''Drammel'' was armed with twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]], twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. 854 crew operated the ship, with sixty-six [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] manning the vessel's armaments; however, if necessary, a skeleton crew of 307 alongside ten gunners could run the ship. The ''Drammel'' was equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], and was capable of [[Lightspeed/Legends|faster-than-light]] travel utilizing a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], with a Class 12 backup unit. Capable of traveling at speeds of 800 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the ''Drammel'' could carry consumables to last two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and had storage space for 6,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. Seventy-five [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] could also be billeted aboard.<ref name="Stats" />

==History==
The ''Drammel'' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was part of the [[Trax Sector Group|forces]] stationed in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]].<ref name="Showdown" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Heggel]]'s entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that he took command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Not long after this, the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]] is constructed, a process that only takes fourteen [[Standard day/Legends|days]].</ref> it was part of a convoy of ships [[Battle of Bissillirus|attacked]] by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] fleet in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]].<ref name="Showdown" />
